steps.subject: Thank you for your generous gift
steps.text:
Dear {{record.donor_name}},

Thank you for your gift of ${{record.amount}} on {{record.received_on | date}}. Our director will call you this week to thank you in person.

No goods or services were provided in exchange for this gift.

{{site.name}}
